🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Natalia sets their bowl down. “Diana, your trade story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Diana. Everybody does.
“You’re right.” Diana doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t veterinarian. I was paramedic. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Diana the bowl without a word.
